Overview

Cartagena is a city in BL with a population of 1,000,000. A stunning colonial walled city on the Caribbean coast, a UNESCO World Heritage site and top tourist destination. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8a growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
